source: ISRO-NRSC Landslide Atlas of India (1998-2022) & Geological Survey of India (GSI)
citation: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC), Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), Dept. of Space, Govt. of India (2023)

historicalEvents.name: Joshimath Slope Subsidence & Slump Zone
historicalEvents.trigger: Subsurface piping, heavy drainage infiltration, fragile moraine base
historicalEvents.description: Widely monitored zone with ground fissures, historic slope debris, and active deformation along NH-7.

historicalEvents.name: Kedarnath - Mandakini Valley Debris Flows
historicalEvents.trigger: Torrential cloudburst and moraine-dammed lake breach (Chorabari)
historicalEvents.description: Historic event mapping thousands of mass movements along the Mandakini and Saraswati valleys.

historicalEvents.name: Badrinath Highway (Lambagarh Landslide)
historicalEvents.trigger: Continuous monsoon rainfall on steep sheared gneiss
historicalEvents.description: Chronic slide zone on the Rishikesh-Badrinath Highway regularly reactivated during intense rainfall.

historicalEvents.name: Karnaprayag Highway Slide Zone
historicalEvents.trigger: Toe erosion by Alaknanda & heavy precipitation
historicalEvents.description: Slope instability affecting settlements and road access at confluence point.

historicalEvents.name: Koteshwar - Tehri Dam Rim Landslide
historicalEvents.trigger: Reservoir fluctuation & intense monsoonal downpour
historicalEvents.description: Mapped slope failures along phyllitic rock formations bordering Tehri catchment.

historicalEvents.name: Summer Hill & Shiv Bawadi Slide
historicalEvents.trigger: Consecutive days of extreme precipitation (>250mm) soaking weathered mica-schist
historicalEvents.description: Catastrophic slope failure that severed the UNESCO Kalka-Shimla railway track and temple area.

historicalEvents.name: Pandoh - Aut NH-21 Slide Stretch
historicalEvents.trigger: Beas river surge, road cutting and saturated metamorphic slopes
historicalEvents.description: Frequent blockage zone on Chandigarh-Manali corridor during July-August monsoons.

historicalEvents.name: Kotropi Massive Landslide
historicalEvents.trigger: Continuous cloudburst rainfall mobilizing thick regolith and clayey matrix
historicalEvents.description: Swept away 250m of National Highway 154; one of the largest recorded single flows in HP.

historicalEvents.name: Dharamshala McLeodganj Slope Creep
historicalEvents.trigger: High rainfall runoff along fragile sandstone-shale contacts
historicalEvents.description: Persistent road sinking and hillside cracks observed during active monsoons.

historicalEvents.name: Chooralmala - Mundakkai Disaster Complex
historicalEvents.trigger: Extreme antecedent rainfall (>570mm in 48 hrs) on steep charnockite scrap
historicalEvents.description: Rapid debris flow initiated in the Vellarmala hills running through Mundakkai and Chooralmala towns.

historicalEvents.name: Puthumala Landslide
historicalEvents.trigger: Severe monsoon depression causing intense groundwater hydrostatic surge
historicalEvents.description: Massive hill slope detachment that buried plantation settlements and road connectivity.

historicalEvents.name: Pettimudi Landslide
historicalEvents.trigger: Intense torrential rain (>300mm/day) on steep weathered scarp
historicalEvents.description: Hill collapsed into tea worker quarters near Eravikulam National Park border.

historicalEvents.name: Kavalappara Landslide
historicalEvents.trigger: 400mm rainfall in 24h triggering subterranean soil piping
historicalEvents.description: Mutthappan hill collapsed burying over 50 houses on the lower terrace.

historicalEvents.name: Paglajhora Sinking Zone
historicalEvents.type: Chronic complex rotational slide & sinking zone
historicalEvents.trigger: Perennial springs, heavy monsoon infiltration in Darjeeling Gneiss
historicalEvents.description: One of the most famous chronic active sinking zones affecting NH-55 and the Darjeeling Toy Train.

historicalEvents.name: Tindharia Landslide Zone
historicalEvents.trigger: Monsoonal slope saturation on steep phyllites
historicalEvents.description: Active slide repeatedly damaging national highway corridor connecting Siliguri to Darjeeling.

historicalEvents.name: Nine Mile Landslide & Sinking Zone
historicalEvents.trigger: High intensity rain and Teesta basin geologic shearing
historicalEvents.description: Regular blockage point isolating North Sikkim during pre-monsoon and monsoon seasons.

historicalEvents.name: Irshalwadi Landslide
historicalEvents.type: Debris Avalanche on Deccan Trap cliff
historicalEvents.trigger: Extremely heavy downpour (>490mm in 72h) saturating basaltic regolith
historicalEvents.description: Steep hill face detachment completely burying an isolated tribal hamlet.

historicalEvents.name: Malin Landslide
historicalEvents.trigger: Torrential rain on terraced hillside with altered natural drainage
historicalEvents.description: Wiped out entire Malin village in the Western Ghats foothills.

historicalEvents.name: Coonoor - Marapalam Landslide Stretch
historicalEvents.trigger: Northeast monsoon intense bursts on steep tea plantation slopes
historicalEvents.description: Frequent slope disruptions on Mettupalayam-Ooty Ghat Road.

historicalEvents.name: Thora - Kakkabe Hill Collapse
historicalEvents.trigger: Continuous rain causing soil overburden saturation
historicalEvents.description: Major hillside detachment near Brahmagiri range affecting plantation settlements.
